svg.title: Web Scraper collection, saved-data and History architecture
svg.desc: An explicit POST passes Express validation and a run service before dispatching one of four bounded source adapters. Validated records or a failure outcome are persisted in MongoDB. Saved-data GET requests read the repository without dispatching a collector. Separate explicit PATCH and confirmed DELETE requests pass History validation and guarded repository mutations to archive, restore or remove stored payloads. Running runs are protected and deleted identities are retained to prevent replay. History actions never dispatch a collector.
